fixed.summary: Under an overcast the sky's strip above the horizon no longer marches the cloud deck four extra times at every pixel: the grey those marches gave is the same for every pixel, so it is made once a frame, with the same pixels. A storm sky over the sea costs about 40% less of the frame (36 ms to 21 ms at 720p on an Apple M4 Pro), a live sky's capture about 45% less.
